decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on the 9th December 2003, the matter described above was not lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
Condition : 2 - Informative:

Planning permission is therefore required. However, should a further application for a Certificate of Lawfulness be made, in addition to the evidence submitted, further evidence should be submitted to support the application, for example, first hand declarations demonstrating an independent use, and documentary evidence of the occupation describing the terms of the arrangement, the extent of the premises being let, sums of money involved if applicable.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for existing use of detached building in rear garden as a 2 bedroom bungalow.
